Willkommen bei X, früher bekannt als Twitter, Ihrem vertrauenswürdigen digitalen Marktplatz wo Gespräche in Echtzeit ablaufen und die Welt sich über Eilmeldungen, Live-Events, Podcasts und alles dazwischen verbindet.

Ob Sie leidenschaftlich an Sport, Technik, Musik oder Politik interessiert sind, X bietet Ihnen einen Platz in der ersten Reihe für das, was weltweit passiert.

X ist nicht nur eine weitere Social-Media-App, sondern das ultimative Ziel, um gut informiert zu bleiben, Ideen zu teilen und Communities aufzubauen. 

Mit X sind Sie immer auf dem Laufenden mit relevanten Trending-Themen und Eilmeldungen, die sofort auf Ihrem Bildschirm erscheinen, roh und ungefiltert.

Was Sie auf X tun können:
• Verfolgen Sie Eilmeldungen aus der ganzen Welt, bevor sie in die Schlagzeilen kommen, und bleiben Sie voraus mit Echtzeit-Updates zu Trending-Themen und viralen Gesprächen.
• Teilen Sie Ihre Gedanken, Fotos und Videos mit einer globalen Community. Schließen Sie sich Millionen von Nutzern an, um den öffentlichen Diskurs in sozialen, kulturellen und politischen Gesprächen zu gestalten.
• Entdecken Sie Grok, den KI-Assistenten, der von den Echtzeit-Daten von X angetrieben wird. Sie können Grok bitten, Trending-News zusammenzufassen, Videos zu erklären oder mehr Kontext zu Beiträgen zu geben.
• Streamen Sie Live-Videos oder gehen Sie live mit Spaces, unserem Audio-Feature, das es Ihnen ermöglicht, Diskussionen zu moderieren, Interviews zu führen oder Ihren nächsten Live-Podcast zu starten. Ob Sie ein Konzert, ein Live-Spiel oder Ihre Gedanken zu einem heißen Thema streamen, X hält Ihr Publikum bei der Stange.
• Schauen Sie Videos: von Live-Eilmeldungen und Sport-Clips bis hin zu Podcasts und Gaming-Sessions, die bis zu 3 Stunden lang sein können. Viele der führenden Stimmen der Welt in Komödie, Gaming, Podcasting und Politik teilen ihren Content auf X.
• Verbinden Sie sich und chatten Sie privat mit Freunden, Followern, Kunden oder Kollaborateuren über Direktnachrichten.
• Treten Sie Communities bei und bauen Sie sie auf, die auf Ihre Interessen zugeschnitten sind: von Sport-News, Gaming, Entertainment, Krypto, Unternehmertum, Tech und mehr.
• Abonnieren Sie X Premium, um exklusive Features freizuschalten wie das blaue Häkchen, erhöhte Sichtbarkeit, priorisierte Antworten, weniger Werbung, längere Videos und die Bearbeitung von Beiträgen. X Premium gibt Ihnen auch Zugang zum Revenue-Sharing für Creator und die Möglichkeit, exklusiven Content für Abonnenten anzubieten.

Warum X?
In einer Welt des ständigen Wandels ist X Ihre Echtzeit-Quelle, um voraus zu sein, mit Menschen in Kontakt zu treten und vielfältige Perspektiven zu erkunden. Von Live-Eilmeldungen und Trending-Memes bis hin zu Top-Podcasts und Live-Streams Ihrer Lieblings-Creator bringt X alles in einer leistungsstarken Social-Erfahrung zusammen.

X (formerly Twitter) is a social media app where you can follow breaking news, live events, and trending topics as they happen. Sports, tech, music, politics: whatever you're into, the conversation starts here, raw and unfiltered.

It's also a place to be heard. Post your take on the day's news, go live, and grow an audience for whatever you create. Millions of people come to X every day to find out what's happening and talk about it.


WHAT YOU CAN DO ON X

- Follow breaking news – Get news from around the world before it hits the headlines, with real-time updates on trending topics and viral conversations.
- Post to a global community – Share your thoughts, photos, and videos. Join millions of users shaping public dialogue across social, cultural, and political conversations.
- Ask Grok – Grok is the AI assistant powered by X's real-time data. Ask Grok to summarize trending news, explain videos, or give you more context about posts. Grok also powers the photo and video editing tools in the app.
- Create original videos – The built-in Video Editor and Recorder lets you shoot, add multi-language captions, apply green screen effects, and post pro-level content directly in the app.
- Go live on video – Stream a concert, a live game, or your thoughts on a hot topic, and keep your audience engaged with enhanced livestream tools.
- Watch video and podcasts – From live breaking news and sports clips to podcasts and gaming sessions up to 3 hours long. Many of the world's leading voices in comedy, gaming, podcasting, and politics share their content on X.
- Host live audio with Spaces – Spaces is X's audio feature for hosting discussions, holding interviews, or starting your next live podcast.
- Message privately – Connect and chat with friends, followers, customers, or collaborators through Direct Messages.
- Pin Custom Timelines – Custom Timelines are Grok-powered topic feeds you can pin for the topics you follow most.
- Turn on Priority Notifications – Priority Notifications surface your key interactions first.
- Open your History tab – The History tab is one unified place for your bookmarks, likes, videos, and articles.
- Subscribe to X Premium – X Premium unlocks a blue checkmark, boosted visibility, prioritized replies, fewer ads, longer videos, and post editing. It also gives you creator revenue sharing and the ability to offer exclusive content to subscribers.

WHO X IS FOR

X is for people who follow breaking news and live events in real time, for sports, tech, music, and politics fans, for creators and podcasters who stream and create original video content for an audience, and for anyone building a community around gaming, entertainment, crypto, entrepreneurship, or tech.

WHY X?

In a world of constant change, X is your real-time source to stay ahead of the curve, connect with people, explore diverse perspectives, and create standout content. From breaking live news and trending memes to top podcasts, live streams, and original videos from your favorite creators, X brings it all together in one powerful social experience.

record.description_evidence:
O Goodnotes foi sempre o lugar ideal para guardar as tuas ideias — de notas rápidas a grandes planos. Agora, vai mais longe. Com uma IA poderosa e novas formas de guardar informações, o Goodnotes ajuda-te a ligar os pontos, a descobrir perspetivas e a colocar ideias em prática.

*Os atuais utilizadores do Goodnotes 5 podem continuar a usar o Goodnotes 5 para sempre ou atualizarem para o novo Goodnotes. De qualquer forma, as tuas notas estão seguras!* 

Para profissionais: Aumenta a produtividade no trabalho
 ■ Quadro branco + IA Goodnotes: Uma das nossas funcionalidades mais pedidas — faz brainstorming, mapas mentais e diagramas livremente numa tela infinita que cresce com as tuas ideias. Ferramentas de diagramação melhoradas e colaboração em tempo real criam condições para as equipas trabalharem em conjunto, criarem ideias e resolverem problemas, enquanto a IA Goodnotes ajuda a guardar e organizar imediatamente os principais pontos. 
■ IA Goodnotes Áudio e Reuniões: Mantém-te totalmente presente em todas as conversas enquanto o Goodnotes faz o trabalho por ti. Transcrição e resumo em tempo real com IA guardam automaticamente as conversas organizando-as em atas de reunião objetivas. Após a reunião, mistura as transcrições com as tuas próprias notas para criar documentos objetivos e partilháveis em segundos. 
■ Documentos de texto + IA: Cria documentos que pensam contigo. Desfruta de uma experiência de digitação superior com blocos inline avançados, desenvolve ideias com perspetivas externas e colabora facilmente com os teus colegas de equipa. Com resumos gerados por IA, criação automática de notas e suporte para transcrições, podes transformar notas e reuniões em conteúdo finalizado mais rápido do que nunca. 
■ Apresenta as tuas notas, slides e conteúdos diretamente do Goodnotes quando ligares o teu dispositivo via AirPlay ou HDMI a um ecrã externo. 
■ Usa o apontador laser para ter a atenção do público durante a apresentação.
■ Exporta as tuas notas para e-mail, imprime ou partilha em qualquer lugar como PDF. 
■ Envia uma hiperligação para os teus cadernos para trabalhares diretamente nas mesmas notas — perfeito para trabalho assíncrono ou brainstorming colaborativo. 
■ Importa documentos enviando-os por e-mail para o teu endereço de e-mail personalizado do Goodnotes. 

Para estudantes: Arrasa nos exames facilmente
■ Grava notas de áudio que são sincronizadas como que por magia com o momento em que escreves — perfeito para palestras ou apresentações.
■ Procura e encontra imediatamente qualquer uma das tuas notas de qualquer aula. 
■ Estuda e pratica diretamente das tuas notas com os Conjuntos de Estudo — cartões de memória baseados na memória ativa e na repetição espaçada. 
■ Usa a IA para resumir, encurtar, mudar o tom das palavras e aperfeiçoar o texto digitado. 

Para quem gosta de planear: Deixa a criatividade fluir 
■ Personaliza o tamanho e a cor dos modelos de papel para criares o modelo que desejas. 
■ Acrescenta, cria ou importa stickers, carimbos, fitas washi, imagens e muito mais 

Cadernos digitais: cadernos ilimitados pelo preço de um único caderno físico. 
■ Mistura escrita à mão e texto digitado numa só página, juntamente com imagens, stickers, diagramas e rabiscos. 
■ Cria cadernos digitais com modelos de papel personalizáveis, incluindo papel em branco, papel pautado, papel Cornell, listas de verificação, agendas e muito mais. 
■ Navega facilmente em documentos longos. Os índices dos PDF são importados automaticamente; ou cria tu mesmo índices personalizados. 
■ Faz backup de todas as notas no Google Drive, Dropbox ou OneDrive e usa o iCloud para sincronizar no iPad, iPhone e Mac, para que as tuas notas fiquem sempre seguras. 
■ Edita o teu texto redimensionando-o, mudando a cor ou movendo-o para outro lugar na página.

互動式學習：與 AI 互動，您的日語聊天夥伴將幫助您在真實對話中應用所學知識。通過我們的對話功能練習口語，並通過每日練習加強您的技能。

全面的內容：掌握與日常生活相關的基本詞彙、語法、聽力和閱讀，例如家庭、工作和問候。此外，通過我們豐富的練習測試準備 JLPT 考試。

個性化的學習路徑：選擇您的學習時長，Easy Japanese 將根據您的目標推薦課程。通過獲得徽章和頭銜來保持學習旅程中的動力。

閱讀和聆聽：訪問每日涵蓋各種主題的新聞文章，從體育到娛樂，提高您的日語閱讀和聽力能力。

詞彙和語法：突出重要詞彙，分析語法結構，並通過閃卡和測驗豐富您的 JLPT 詞彙。

JLPT 考試準備：參加所有級別的模擬考試，跟蹤您的進度，以達到您想要的 JLPT 級別。

聆聽練習：通過音頻文章、播客和視頻來提高您的發音和聽力技能。

離線模式：隨時隨地學習日語，即使沒有互聯網連接也可以。

發問、獲得答案，並與來自超過 170 個不同國家的母語人士聯繫！

有了 Easy Japanese，掌握日語從未如此方便和有趣。立即開始您的語言學習之旅，開啟無限可能性！

Lingrow is an AI language learning app built around real voice conversations. Talk to an AI partner that listens, responds, and adapts to your level. Like having a private tutor in your pocket, available 24/7.

SPEAK WITHOUT FEAR

The hardest part of learning a language is opening your mouth. Lingrow gives you a space to make mistakes, stumble through sentences, and actually build confidence. Practice that prepares you for real conversations with real people.

REAL SCENARIOS, REAL PROGRESS

Practice the conversations you'll actually have. Ordering coffee, navigating the metro, chatting with friends, handling a job interview. Every scenario is culturally authentic, based on how locals really speak.

• 350+ conversation scenarios across everyday life, travel, work, social, food, dating, and more
• Voice conversations with an AI that adapts to your pace and skill level
• Beginner, intermediate, and advanced difficulty levels
• New scenarios and features added regularly

LEARN STEP BY STEP WITH GUIDED LESSONS

Follow structured lessons that build real skills one step at a time, tailored to your level. Each lesson teaches the words, phrases, and grammar you need, then puts them straight to use in conversation.

• 100+ guided lessons that take you from beginner to confident
• Lessons matched to your level and goals
• New lessons added regularly

BUILD VOCABULARY THAT STICKS

Lock in new words with flashcards that adapt to your memory. Our cutting-edge review system learns from you and brings back each word at exactly the right time, so you study less and remember more.

• Thousands of words in curated decks, from the 100 most common words to exam-level vocabulary
• A review system that learns from you and times every review perfectly
• Native audio and example sentences
• Save words from your conversations into your own deck
• Daily review reminders to keep you consistent

DETAILED SPEAKING FEEDBACK

Get real-time feedback as you speak, so you can correct mistakes and learn in the moment. After each conversation, get a full personalised summary breaking down your grammar, vocabulary, fluency, and how well you hit your learning goals. You get specific tips tailored to your weak spots so you know exactly what to work on next.

• Personalised feedback based on your goals and skill level
• Actionable tips that tell you exactly how to improve
• Conversation scores that track your improvement over time
• Learning goals that track the words and phrases you've practised
• Daily streaks to keep you consistent

WHY LEARNERS CHOOSE LINGROW

• Speaking practice is the fastest path to fluency
• A fraction of the cost of a private language tutor
• Practice speaking anytime, anywhere
• Make mistakes without anyone judging you
• Conversations adapt to your skill level automatically

Learn Korean, learn Japanese, learn Spanish, learn French, learn Italian, learn Chinese, learn German, learn Portuguese, and more. Whether you're preparing for a trip, living abroad, connecting with family, or picking up a new language, Lingrow gives you the confidence to speak for real.

Lingrow offers auto-renewing subscriptions. Subscribe to Lingrow Premium for full access to all scenarios, conversation features, and detailed feedback.

Payment will be charged to your Apple account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Auto-renewal may be turned off at any time by going to your settings in the App Store after purchase.

record.name: 法语助手 FrenchMate
record.offering: Education app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
FrenchMate 是为认真备考的法语学习者打造的 AI 助教——专为 TCF、TEF、DELF 而生，而不是为了打卡连胜。

市面上大多数语言 App 都在用游戏化堆砌零碎短语。FrenchMate 只做两件考生每天都在做的事：用自然语言追问真实法语，集中刷会出现在考试里的核心词。

【问什么都行】
输入任意法语词、整句法语，或者直接用中文问"X 怎么用法语说"。FrenchMate 给你:
• 地道的法语回答
• 音节级别的发音标注
• 词性与阴阳性
• 真实语境中的例句
• 这个词/句子在什么场景下用

不用翻菜单、不用排课程，打开就问。

【对话练习】
切到 Dialogue 模式，AI 用地道法语跟你聊；你可以用法语或中文回，每一句都带翻译和音频。等于一个随叫随到的法国搭子——TCF / DELF 口语题型直接来练。

【单词本】
精选 TCF 高频核心词表，配遗忘曲线算法的间隔复习。每个词标"熟"或"不熟"，下一次复习时间自动安排。目标是 B2 考生必须掌握的约 1200 个核心词。

【收藏夹】
聊天里看到喜欢的句子或单词，点一下保存到个人收藏。不会自动收集——所有内容都由你主动决定。

【练口语 + 磨耳朵】
每条例句都配地道法语音频，点喇叭反复听到入脑。点麦克风用法语回应——语音在设备本地转写，AI 实时纠正发音、阴阳性、动词变位。考前练，第一天就能上手。

【为什么选 FrenchMate】
• 为考试而生，不是为打卡而生
• 发音尊重联诵和省音——同一个词在不同句子里的实际读法都会告诉你为什么
• 每条回答都标阴阳性和冠词
• 动词变位覆盖各种时态，不只是现在时
• 用你的母语解释——中文、英文等
• 复习功能离线可用，AI 功能需要联网

【适合谁】
• 备考 TCF / TEF / DELF 的 B1 → B2 学员
• 受够了 Duolingo 游戏化的自学者
• 在法国留学、工作、生活，需要"真正的法语"而不是教材法语的人
• 习惯手写词汇本、想把同样的工作流搬到手机上的人

O ConvoLive é prática de conversação gratuita para inglês, espanhol, francês, japonês, italiano, alemão, português, chinês mandarim e coreano: você fala em voz alta, um personagem de IA responde, e não existe assinatura.

Você entende um idioma muito melhor do que consegue falar. Quem já estudou um conhece essa sensação: as palavras estão ali, mas não saem na frente de uma pessoa de verdade.

O ConvoLive é prática de conversação. Você fala em voz alta, um personagem responde, e reage ao que você realmente disse, não ao que um roteiro esperava.

Sem assinatura, sem bloqueio pago
Não existe versão premium nem cenários bloqueados. Você entra com e-mail, Google ou Apple, sem senha para decorar, e não há dados de pagamento para informar.

Uma cidade que lembra de você
Você abre o app e volta para a sua cidade: um elenco de personagens que você reencontra sempre, relacionamentos que crescem quanto mais você conversa com eles, e um contador de dias que registra há quanto tempo você está voltando. Um diário guarda quem você já conheceu e o que vem a seguir. Prefere ir direto para uma situação? O Chat rápido mantém a lista completa: pedir um café, fazer check-in em um hotel, passar pela alfândega.

Objetivos de verdade, não um bate-papo sem fim
Cada conversa, na cidade ou no Chat rápido, começa com uma lista curta de coisas para fazer. Peça três maçãs. Pergunte quanto é. Cada item é marcado assim que você realmente cumpre o objetivo, e nada é roteirizado, então a marcação é a prova de que você chegou lá sozinho. É assim também que você sabe que terminou, algo que uma janela de chat sem fim nunca diz.

Cada turno acontece em voz alta
Aqui não dá para escapar digitando. Ler um idioma e falar são habilidades diferentes, e a que você segue evitando é a que continua difícil.

Uma saída quando você trava
Sempre há algumas frases sugeridas à mão. Reproduza uma para ouvir como deve soar, fale você mesmo, ou traduza antes se não tiver certeza do significado. Se o que você quer dizer não está entre elas, digite no seu idioma e receba de volta no idioma que está aprendendo, sem sair da conversa.

Toque em qualquer palavra e entenda o contexto
A palavra é explicada bem onde está, no sentido que ela tem naquela frase. Em inglês, "fine" é "bem", ou "uma multa", ou "fino", dependendo da linha em que apareceu, e um dicionário te dá um desses ao acaso. Se o que escapou foi a frase inteira, isso também se toca.

Descreva uma situação e ganhe uma conversa
Peça a bênção ao pai do seu parceiro. Pergunte à sua sogra como ela faz a quiche dela. Explique uma alergia de pele para um farmacêutico em um país onde você acabou de chegar. A situação que realmente te preocupa não está na lista de nenhum curso, então escreva uma frase descrevendo-a e pratique aqui primeiro.

Idiomas para praticar: Inglês, espanhol, francês, japonês, italiano, alemão, chinês mandarim, português e coreano, com mais a caminho. Idiomas da interface: inglês, espanhol, francês, alemão, italiano, português, japonês, coreano, chinês, russo, turco, indonésio e hindi.

ConvoLive 是一款免费的口语练习应用，支持英语、西班牙语、法语、日语、意大利语、德语、葡萄牙语、中文和韩语：你开口说，AI 角色就会回应，不需要订阅。

一门语言，你能读懂的往往比能说出口的多。学过外语的人都懂这种感觉：话都在脑子里，可真到了要开口的时候，就是说不出来。

ConvoLive 专门练口语。你开口说，AI 角色就回应，回应的是你真正说出的话，而不是脚本预设的答案。

无需订阅，没有付费门槛
没有高级版，也没有被锁住的场景库。用邮箱、Google 或 Apple 账号登录即可，不用记密码，也不需要填写任何支付信息。

一座记得你的小镇
打开应用，你又回到了自己的小镇：一群会反复遇见的角色，聊得越多，关系越深，还有一个天数计数器，记录你已经坚持了多久。日志会记下你见过谁、接下来该做什么。只想练一个场景？快速对话保留着完整列表：点咖啡、办理酒店入住、过海关，都在里面。

有目标的对话，不是没完没了的闲聊
不管是在小镇还是快速对话里，每段对话都从一份简短的任务清单开始。买三个苹果。问一共多少钱。真正做到的那一刻，任务才会打勾。没有剧本，也没人告诉你该怎么说，这个勾就是你靠自己完成的证明。你也因此知道什么时候算结束，这一点，一个只会无限延续下去的聊天窗口给不了你。

每一句都要说出来
在这里没法靠打字蒙混过关。读和说是两种不同的能力，你越回避哪一种，哪一种就越难提高。

卡壳时的出路
屏幕上始终有几句参考表达。点开听发音，跟着说一遍，拿不准意思就先看翻译。想说的话不在其中时，用母语输入，就能马上得到你正在学习的语言的表达，不用离开对话界面。

看不懂的词，点一下就懂
这个词会按它在这句话里的实际意思来解释。英语单词 "run" 可以是"跑步"，也可以是"经营一家店"，还可以是"把什么用完了"，具体是哪个意思取决于它出现的那句话，而词典只会随机给你其中一个。如果看不懂的是整句话，同样点一下就行。

描述一个场景，就能生成一段对话
向对象的父亲请求祝福。向婆婆请教她的法式咸派怎么做。在刚落地的国家，向药剂师描述身上的皮疹。真正让你发怵的场景，从来不在任何课程列表里，写一句话描述它，先在这里练一遍。

练习语言：英语、西班牙语、法语、日语、意大利语、德语、中文、葡萄牙语、韩语，未来还会增加更多。界面语言：英语、西班牙语、法语、德语、意大利语、葡萄牙语、日语、韩语、中文、俄语、土耳其语、印尼语、印地语。

ConvoLive ist kostenloses Sprechtraining für Englisch, Spanisch, Französisch, Japanisch, Italienisch, Deutsch, Portugiesisch, Mandarin und Koreanisch: Du sprichst laut, eine KI-Figur antwortet dir, und es gibt kein Abo.

Du verstehst eine Sprache schriftlich besser, als du sie sprechen kannst. Jeder, der eine Sprache gelernt hat, kennt dieses Gefühl: Die Wörter sind da, und sie kommen einfach nicht heraus, sobald ein echter Mensch vor dir steht.

ConvoLive ist Sprechtraining. Du sprichst laut, eine KI-Figur antwortet dir, und sie reagiert auf das, was du wirklich gesagt hast, nicht auf das, was ein Skript erwartet hätte.

Kein Abo, keine Bezahlschranke
Es gibt keine Premium-Stufe und keine gesperrte Szenario-Bibliothek. Melde dich mit E-Mail-Adresse, Google oder Apple an, ohne Passwort zum Merken, und es gibt keine Zahlungsdaten einzugeben.

Eine Stadt, die sich an dich erinnert
Öffne die App und du bist zurück in deiner Stadt: eine Besetzung an Figuren, die du immer wieder triffst, Beziehungen, die wachsen, je mehr du mit ihnen sprichst, und ein Tageszähler, der zeigt, wie lange du schon dabei bist. Ein Tagebuch hält fest, wen du getroffen hast und was als Nächstes kommt. Lieber direkt in eine Situation springen? Quick Chat behält die volle Liste: einen Kaffee bestellen, im Hotel einchecken, durch den Zoll kommen.

Echte Ziele statt endlosem Chat
Jedes Gespräch, in der Stadt oder im Quick Chat, beginnt mit einer kurzen Liste an Dingen, die zu erledigen sind. Drei Äpfel bestellen. Nach dem Preis fragen. Jeder Punkt wird abgehakt, sobald du ihn wirklich erledigst, und nichts ist vorgeschrieben, also ist der Haken der Beleg, dass du es selbst geschafft hast. Und du weißt dadurch auch, wann du fertig bist, was dir ein Chatfenster, das einfach immer weiterläuft, nie sagen würde.

Jeder Gesprächsbeitrag wird gesprochen
Hier kommst du mit Tippen nicht durch. Eine Sprache zu lesen und sie zu sprechen sind zwei getrennte Fähigkeiten, und die, die du ständig vermeidest, bleibt die schwierige.

Ein Ausweg, wenn du hängst
Ein paar Formulierungsvorschläge stehen immer bereit. Spiele einen ab, um zu hören, wie es klingen soll, sprich ihn selbst, oder übersetze ihn zuerst, wenn du dir nicht sicher bist, was er bedeutet. Fehlt das, was du sagen willst, tippst du es in deiner eigenen Sprache und bekommst es in der Sprache zurück, die du lernst, ohne das Gespräch zu verlassen.

Tippe auf ein Wort und verstehe es im Kontext
Das Wort wird genau dort erklärt, wo es steht, in der Bedeutung, die der Satz tatsächlich meint. Englisch „run“ heißt „joggen“, oder „ein Unternehmen führen“, oder „fließen“, je nachdem, in welcher Zeile es auftaucht, und ein Wörterbuch gibt dir zufällig eine davon. Ist dir der ganze Satz entglitten, reicht dafür ebenfalls ein Antippen.

Beschreibe eine Situation, bekomme ein Gespräch
Bitte den Vater deines Partners um seinen Segen. Frag deine Schwiegermutter, wie sie ihre Quiche macht. Erkläre einem Apotheker einen Ausschlag, in einem Land, in dem du erst gestern gelandet bist. Die Situation, vor der du dich wirklich fürchtest, steht auf keiner Kursliste, also schreib einen Satz, der sie beschreibt, und übe sie hier zuerst.

Übungssprachen: Englisch, Spanisch, Französisch, Japanisch, Italienisch, Deutsch, Mandarin, Portugiesisch und Koreanisch, mit weiteren in Vorbereitung. Interface-Sprachen: Englisch, Spanisch, Französisch, Deutsch, Italienisch, Portugiesisch, Japanisch, Koreanisch, Chinesisch, Russisch, Türkisch, Indonesisch und Hindi.

ConvoLive is free speaking practice for English, Spanish, French, Japanese, Italian, German, Portuguese, Mandarin Chinese and Korean: you talk out loud, an AI character talks back, and there is no subscription.

You can read more of a language than you can say. Everybody who has studied one knows the feeling: the words are in there, and they will not come out in front of an actual person.

ConvoLive is speaking practice. You talk out loud, an AI character talks back, and it answers what you actually said rather than what a script was expecting.

No subscription, no paywall
There is no premium tier and no locked scenario library. Sign in with an email address, Google or Apple, with no password to remember, and there are no payment details to enter.

A town that remembers you
Open the app and you are back in your town: a cast of characters you keep meeting, relationships that grow the more you talk to them, and a day counter that tracks how long you have been coming back. A journal keeps a record of who you have met and what is next. Prefer to jump into one scenario instead? Quick chat keeps the full list: ordering coffee, checking into a hotel, getting through customs.

Real goals, not open-ended chat
Every conversation, in the town or in Quick chat, opens with a short list of things to get done. Order three apples. Ask for the total. Each one ticks off the moment you actually do it, and nothing is scripted, so the tick is proof you got there yourself. It is also how you know you are finished, which a chat window that just keeps going never tells you.

Every turn is spoken
You cannot type your way through this one. Reading a language and speaking it are separate skills, and the one you keep avoiding is the one that stays hard.

A way out when you freeze
A few suggested lines are always sitting there. Play one to hear how it should sound, say it yourself, or translate it first if you are not sure what it means. When the thing you want to say is not among them, type that in your own language and get it back in the language you are learning, without leaving the conversation.

Tap any word and understand it in context
The word gets explained right where it sits, in the sense the sentence is actually using. Spanish "queda" is "it remains", or "it suits you", or "let us meet", depending on the line it turned up in, and a dictionary hands you one of those at random. If it was the whole sentence that got away from you, that is a tap as well.

Describe a situation, get a conversation
Ask your partner's father for his blessing. Ask your mother-in-law how she makes her quiche. Explain a rash to a pharmacist in a country you landed in yesterday. The situation you are actually dreading is not in anyone's course list, so write a sentence describing it and practice it here first.

Practice languages: English, Spanish, French, Japanese, Italian, German, Mandarin Chinese, Portuguese and Korean, with more coming. Interface languages: English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Japanese, Korean, Chinese, Russian, Turkish, Indonesian and Hindi.

ConvoLive は英語・スペイン語・フランス語・日本語・イタリア語・ドイツ語・ポルトガル語・中国語・韓国語を無料で話す練習ができるアプリです。声に出して話すとAIキャラクターが答え、サブスクは不要です。

外国語は、読めても話せないもの。勉強したことがある人なら誰でも分かる感覚です。単語は頭の中にあるのに、いざ人を前にすると出てこない。

ConvoLive はスピーキング専用の練習アプリです。声に出して話すとAIキャラクターが答えます。台本どおりの答えを待っているのではなく、あなたが実際に話した内容に答えます。

サブスクなし、課金の壁なし
有料プランも、ロックされたシナリオもありません。メールアドレス、Google、Apple のいずれかでログインでき、覚えておくパスワードもなければ、入力する支払い情報もありません。

あなたを覚えている街
アプリを開くと、そこはいつもの街。何度も顔を合わせるキャラクターたちがいて、話すほどに関係が深まり、通った日数はカウンターで分かります。誰と会って次は何をするかは、ジャーナルに記録されます。一つのシーンだけ練習したいときは、クイックチャットへ。カフェでの注文、ホテルのチェックイン、税関の通過まで、シーンは全部そのまま残っています。

目的のある会話。終わりのない雑談ではなく
街でもクイックチャットでも、会話は必ず短いToDoリストから始まります。りんごを3つ注文する。合計金額を聞く。実際にやり遂げた瞬間にチェックが付きます。台本もなければ言い方の指示もないので、そのチェックは自分の力でできた証拠です。どこで終わりなのかも、これで分かります。延々と続くだけのチャット画面には、それが分かりません。

会話はすべて声に出して
文字入力だけで乗り切ることはできません。読む力と話す力は別のスキルで、避け続けている方こそ、いつまでも苦手なままです。

詰まったときの逃げ道
いくつかの例文が常に用意されています。再生して発音を確認し、そのまま言ってみる。意味が不安なら先に訳を確認することもできます。言いたいことが例文にないときは、日本語で入力すれば、学習中の言語に訳されます。会話の画面を離れる必要はありません。

分からない単語はタップひとつ
その単語は、その場で使われている意味のまま説明されます。英語の"run"は、"走る"という意味にも、"店を経営する"という意味にも、"何かを切らす"という意味にもなり、出てきた文によって変わります。辞書はその中のどれか一つをランダムに示すだけです。文全体が分からなかったときも、タップすれば同じように説明が出ます。

場面を書けば、会話ができる
恋人の父親に結婚の許しをもらう。義理の母にキッシュの作り方を聞く。昨日着いたばかりの国で、薬剤師に湿疹の症状を説明する。本当に不安な場面ほど、どのコースにも載っていません。だからこそ、その場面を一文で書けば、ここで先に練習できます。

学習できる言語：英語、スペイン語、フランス語、日本語、イタリア語、ドイツ語、中国語、ポルトガル語、韓国語（今後さらに追加予定）。表示言語：英語、スペイン語、フランス語、ドイツ語、イタリア語、ポルトガル語、日本語、韓国語、中国語、ロシア語、トルコ語、インドネシア語、ヒンディー語。

IELTS Writing AI Checker – 专为雅思写作打造的AI智能批改工具
收录剑桥雅思官方习题册（剑桥C8-C21）和历年考场真题，我们的AI导师助你更快实现雅思写作目标分数。

核心功能：
1.	剑桥雅思习题册与考场真题批改：
•	覆盖剑桥雅思系列Task1,Task2,考官批改建议及真实考题。
•	精准匹配雅思考试标准，针对性备考更高效。

2.	精准作文反馈与写作分数评估：
•	针对你的原创作文提供清晰的语法、词汇与结构优化建议。
•	确保符合雅思评分标准，提供准确的分数评估。
	
3.	高分范文示例：
•	提供不同分数段的高质量范文。
•	清晰展示达到目标分数所需的写作要素。
	
4.	语法与拼写修正：
•	智能检测并修正语法、标点及拼写错误，提高写作准确性。
	
5.	答案润色与重构：
•	优化句子表达，提升句子的清晰度、简洁性与逻辑流畅性。
•	打造结构严谨、表达精准的高质量答案。
	
6.	高分写作库精选：
•	提供高分作文范例，助你掌握结构、词汇及写作思路。
	
7.	详细反馈与可执行改进建议：
•	逐步解析评分要点，提供具体改进方向。
•	帮助你提升任务完成度、连贯性及词汇丰富度。
